strategy.summary: The shop (catalogue, product pages, cookie cart, checkout) has no smoke suite. Add tests/shop.smoke.spec.js: five fast Playwright tests, each tagged @smoke, that reach the app only through the configured baseURL (BASE_URL when set) and only read. Together they show the build is up, its catalogue, product pages, cart and checkout page are reachable and show what a shopper expects. Placing an order is not done, because it is the only request that writes data on the server.
inScope: Product page reached from the catalogue
Adding to the cart (a browser cookie only; no server request) and the cart page
Checkout page rendering its order form (not submitted)
outOfScope: Placing an order (POST /orders): it is the only request that writes server data, so it is left to the existing checkout.spec.js
Error paths (404, empty cart, form validation): a smoke suite checks critical paths only
Running the suite in this run: the target is a non-disposable deployed build; the PR's CI runs it
assumptions: Adding to the cart counts as read-only: public/app.js writes only the browser's cart cookie and sends no request, and README says POST /orders is the only request that changes anything on the server. Each Playwright test has its own browser context, so the cookie never outlives the test.
The catalogue is code (src/catalogue.js PRODUCTS), not seeded data, so every environment of the same build shows it; the tests import PRODUCTS/formatPrice rather than copying names and prices.
No first-party service is faked: without BASE_URL the config starts the real server (node src/server.js); with it the tests hit the deployed build.
openQuestions: The repo has no lint or type-check scripts; the new file can only be checked by run_checks and the Playwright run in CI.

risks.description: A smoke test that writes data would place orders in production
risks.mitigation: No test submits the checkout form or sends a non-GET request; the checkout test only asserts the form is shown.

risks.description: Tests tied to a host would check the wrong build
risks.mitigation: Only relative URLs, resolved against the configured baseURL.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The app is up: GET /health answers 200 with {"status":"ok"}
The catalogue home page loads and lists every product with its price
A shopper can open a product page from the catalogue and sees its name and price
A shopper can add a product to the cart and the cart page shows it with the right total
With items in the cart, the checkout page shows the order form
Every smoke test is tagged @smoke in its title, reaches the app only through the base URL, and creates, changes or deletes no server data
acceptanceCriteria.metBy: tests/shop.smoke.spec.js uses only relative page.goto/request.get paths against the config's baseURL, @smoke in each title, and never submits the checkout form or sends a non-GET request.

testCases.title: health endpoint reports the shop is up @smoke
testCases.rationale: Critical path: the build starts and answers at all.

testCases.title: catalogue lists every product with its price @smoke
testCases.expected: Heading 'Our teaware'; a link for each product in PRODUCTS (exact name) and each product's formatted price shown
testCases.rationale: Critical path: the shop's front page, where every visit starts.

testCases.title: opens a product page from the catalogue @smoke
testCases.expected: URL /products/teapot; heading 'Cast-iron teapot'; price £48.00 and an 'Add to cart' button visible
testCases.rationale: Critical path: shoppers reach products via catalogue links.

testCases.title: adds a product to the cart and shows it on the cart page @smoke
testCases.expected: Status 'Added to your cart'; cart link reads 'Cart (1)'; cart page heading 'Your cart', a row for 'Cast-iron teapot' and 'Total: £48.00'
testCases.rationale: Critical path: the cart (client cookie + server-rendered cart page); writes no server data.

testCases.title: checkout page shows the order form for the cart @smoke
testCases.expected: Heading 'Checkout'; Name, Email, Address fields and a 'Place order' button visible; form is NOT submitted
testCases.rationale: Critical path: the checkout page renders, without placing an order.

strategy.environmentNotes: BASE_URL selects a deployed build; without it playwright.config.js starts node src/server.js on localhost:4175. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs `npx playwright test`, which includes the new file; smoke runs filter with `--grep @smoke`.

refusals.reason: tests/shop.smoke.spec.js written before testforge:api, testforge:playwright were loaded
`playwright` runs tests, and this run writes a smoke suite for http://host.docker.internal:57595, which isn't marked disposable, without running it.
